Paleo Blueberry Muffins Recipe [Grain-Free, Gluten-Free]
By: Paleo Flourish
Published: Thursday, July 12, 2018 - 10:59pm

Ingredients




3 cups almond flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
½ cup ghee, melted
3 eggs
1/2 cup raw honey
1 cup blueberries
1 tablespoon vanilla extract
EQUIPMENT – muffin pan and muffin liners

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350F. 2 Combine the almond flour, baking soda, ghee, eggs, raw honey, and vanilla extract together and mix well. 3 Lastly, fold in the blueberries. 4 Line a muffin pan with muffin liners. Spoon the mixture into the muffin pan (to around 3/4 full) and level out with a spoon. 5 Bake for 18-20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean when you insert it into a muffin.

About

DESCRIPTION: These blueberry muffins are super tasty and delicious.
